drift-hunters.title: Drift Hunters: Experience the Thrill of Online Drifting
drift-hunters.slogan: Master the art of drift racing in Drift Hunters!
drift-hunters.description: Get ready for intense online 3D racing with Drift Hunters! Experience the thrill of drifting with classic and modern sports cars. Customize your ride and conquer challenging tracks. Play Drift Hunters for free now!

HomeIframe.title: Drift Hunters
HomeIframe.description: Drift Hunters is an online 3D car drifting game.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Drift Hunters is an online 3D car drifting game where you can drift iconic cars!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use keyboard or on-screen controls to control your car.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Master braking, throttle control, and angle adjustment for smooth drifts.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Compete in various modes, like free roam or drift battles.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Choose from over 25 drift cars, including classic sports cars and modern supercars in Drift Hunters.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Fine-tune your car's performance and appearance with engine upgrades and visual modifications.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Experience 10 unique tracks, from open spaces to winding city streets.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Enjoy a challenging yet rewarding drift experience with advanced physics simulation in Drift Hunters.
